sources.title: CHURRO: Making History Readable with an Open-Weight Large Vision ...
sources.snippet: This paper presents CHURRO, a 3B-parameter open-weight VLM specialized for historical text recognition. The model is trained on CHURRO-DS 1, the largest historical text recognition dataset to date. CHURRO-DS uni-fies 155 historical corpora comprising 99,491 pages, spanning 22 centuries of textual heritage across 46 language clusters, including histori-cal variants and dead languages.

sources.title: Churro/README.md at main · stanford-oval/Churro · GitHub
sources.snippet: CHURRO is a 3B-parameter open-weight vision-language model (VLM) for historical document transcription. It is trained on CHURRO-DS, a curated dataset of ~100K pages from 155 historical collections spanning 22 centuries and 46 language clusters. On the CHURRO-DS test set, CHURRO delivers 15.5× lower cost than Gemini 2.5 Pro while exceeding its accuracy.
